model: Eaton Pow-R-Command PRC100 / Mod100 lighting panel via BASgatewayLX
applies_to: Eaton Pow-R-Command lighting control panelboards with remote-operated breakers (PRC100 / Mod100 controller), read over Modbus by a BASgatewayLX.
summary: Gateway profile for the Pow-R-Command panel: 464 objects (64 AI, 208 BI, 192 BO), 320 polled by default. For up to 64 breakers it has a writable peer coil (BO) plus read-only command, feedback and alarm coil bits; further unpolled bits and registers cover condition codes, schedules, input override timers and load egress timers.
notes: Built from Contemporary Controls' BASgatewayLX Modbus device profile Eaton_Pow_R_Command_PRC100_MOD100_a_LX.csv; the profile maps the registers in the Pow-R-Command Modbus register list (https://www.ccontrols.com/support/dp/IL01412015E.PDF).
Object instances are the ones this profile assigns when it is loaded into the gateway. A site that edited or rebuilt the profile may use different instances.
Only 320 of the 464 rows are flagged for polling in the profile; the rest are served only after you tick them in the gateway. Their descriptions say "not polled by default".

The CSV has no read/write column: Analog/Binary Inputs are read-only and Analog/Binary Outputs are commandable (priority array), which is how the gateway maps them (access inferred). Descriptions give the Modbus register each object reads.
Breakers 03-64 follow the same pattern as 01 and 02: peer coil BO n, feedback coil BI 192+n, alarm coil BI 288+n.

integration.summary: Write the peer coil for each breaker you switch and read its feedback coil; watch the alarm coils.
setup: The BASgatewayLX presents each Modbus device as its own virtual BACnet device on BACnet IP; give it a unique device instance and Modbus address (serial) or IP address (Modbus TCP) when you add it with this profile.
One BASgatewayLX handles up to 100 Modbus devices and 1000 polled points in total, so leave unneeded rows unpolled.
gotchas: Check the Pow-R-Command documentation for how peer coils interact with the panel's own schedules before the BMS takes over a breaker.
Unpolled rows do not appear as BACnet objects until enabled in the gateway's device profile page.
